metadata.title: Micron Stock Moves Past AI Fears With Launch of New Memory Module<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Moves Past AI Fears With Launch of New Memory Module
Micron Technology stock was rising Tuesday as investors stopped panicking about a halt to artificial-intelligence progress as it announced a new memory module.
